decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in symptom-log and the same-file contrast probe: the tab is claimed/titled but meta.status stays 'none' while file-trace's own RPC reads the file, localizing the fault to the workspace-files resource-provider/RPC metadata chain and ruling out disk, session lookup, the plugin renderer, and static serving (explicitly noting 62/62 200 is not proof of activation). It honestly declines to name an exact unseen internal failing function.

Uses combo-probe.txt to rank the per-module 62/62 sweep as the valid measurement, explaining the loader reads the boot roster and fetches each entry by its own advertised per-module URL/rev, while the hand-joined ~4-5 KB URL is out-of-contract and its 404 plausibly reflects join/length limits and must never be cited as missing modules. No invented reconciliation of the 60-vs-62 count is offered.

Fences the paste-input fold warnings off as an independent warning family (different component, warning-level, no explanatory power) without demanding an unseen fix version, and uses the boot manifest to explain the textpreview-to-documentpreview rename and the new session-only canOpen scope, tying that scope to the absolute-address claim failure but explicitly not to the session tab's stalled metadata.

Orders restart-once, then pinned rollback to the 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch from discussion-excerpt.txt, then upstream follow-up; rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback as concealment of a host defect, and frames the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art with the opposite signature rather than proof of missing alpha.2 bytes.

Packages versions/upgrade history, exact address and symptom, roster excerpt, valid per-module sweep, same-file contrast with meta.status, and the invalid-join caveat, and proposes concrete boot/first-use diagnostics (roster self-probe and an end-to-end workspace-files Remote readiness probe via the client gateway lane) plus fail-loud UI behavior instead of an empty tab.
